cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Closer on My Terms
cards.instruction: Agree to repair the relationship while redefining closeness around the boundaries that benefit you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've closed my menu like you. Dinner sorted. Yes, let's reconnect, but I'll leave at ten.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I closed it because I forgot my reading glasses. We haven't ordered, let alone talked about why you left.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, we'll order together. Tell me the difficult part before pudding so we can finish nicely.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What if I'm still upset at ten?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we'll book another dinner. I'll keep coming, but I want a finishing time each night.

reason: Build an actual mistaken imitation into the shared activity, preserving distinct competitive-care, hopeful-connection, warm-resentment, emotional-pricing, and self-serving-repair tactics.
